notes: The 9C development seeds are reused only to develop the adaptive acquisition policy; 136-145 remain untouched confirmation seeds. Each client starts with three 0.25 s records at one local speed. While normalized covariance trace exceeds 0.05, it adds up to two one-second records at deterministic complementary speed offsets. The 2.75 s maximum remains below the three-second 9B baseline. Development passes only if AdaptiveSoft is within 5% of OracleAdaptive, improves ShortPoint, uses less mean data than FixedFull, is feasible/frozen-stable, and retains fewer shared models than LocalAdaptive. Confirmation opens only after development passes. No privacy is applied.
